meta.title: Sample shopping organizer dataset
meta.netPriceRule: priceNet = priceGross/1.23, only where vatDeductible is true (new items from a shop that can issue a VAT invoice). null otherwise.
meta.urlRule: Sample links use https://example.com and are not real shop pages. Leave url as an empty string when a row has no link.

sources.Sample notes: Fictional rows written so the site can be opened without access control. Not taken from a chat or a receipt.

meta.supplement: The previous personal extract was replaced with this sample. Prices, shop names, quotes, and links are invented. example.com URLs are placeholders.

preferences.rule: Cheaper wins, but a few days of local shipping beats a small saving from a slow overseas parcel. A saving under about 10% is not worth waiting a month.
preferences.quote: Cheaper is better, until the parcel takes a month.

preferences.rule: A company invoice can deduct 23% VAT on new goods from a shop that issues one. Compare those at net (gross/1.23) against used or private listings, which stay at the sticker price.
preferences.quote: If the shop can write a VAT invoice, compare the net.

preferences.rule: Desk accessories should be black: arm, cables, mousepad, and cable grommet. The desktop itself is a light wood top.
Try chairs, headphones, and speakers in a shop before ordering, when a local shop stocks them.
Prefer a known shop or a listing with many sales. Skip a marketplace offer that is only a few zloty cheaper and has no reviews.
Black Friday is a reason to wait only when the item is already in stock and the current price is the full list price. Do not wait on a one-off used listing.

topics.title: Closed studio headphones
topics.summary: Need closed headphones for calls and late-night editing. Open-back pairs were ruled out because the room is shared.
topics.decision: Buy the Northwind NC-700 from the sample shop at 899 zł. The cheaper market listing has no return window.
quotes: Closed back, or I will hear the kitchen.
Add the 899 zł pair to the list and stop looking.
findings: The 700 g pair is fine for two-hour sessions; the heavier studio set was tiring.
A detachable cable matters more than Bluetooth for this desk.
The marketplace pair is the same shell with a grey-import warranty.

options.name: Northwind NC-700
options.notes: Pick. Two-year shop warranty and a 30-day return.

options.name: Northwind NC-700
options.notes: No link captured. Private seller, no VAT invoice.

options.name: Harbour Studio One
options.notes: Heavier. Better isolation, worse for long calls.

nextSteps: Order the NC-700 on a VAT invoice.

topics.title: Mesh Wi-Fi kit
topics.summary: Looked at a two-node Wi-Fi 7 kit after a dead spot in the back room.
topics.decision: Dropped. A single access point on ethernet in the hall covers the flat. A mesh kit would only add a second SSID to manage.
quotes: If one cable fixes it, skip the mesh.
findings: The back room is one plaster wall away from the hall, not a separate floor.
The kit's app wanted a cloud account for a guest network.

options.name: Lumen Mesh 2-pack
options.notes: List price for the two-node kit.

options.name: Hall access point
options.notes: What actually got used. Kept here so the dropped topic still has a price.

topics.title: 16-inch laptop
topics.summary: A second machine for travel. The current laptop stays at the desk. Looking at 32 GB of memory and a matte panel.
topics.decision: Still open. The 32 GB model is the one to price. Do not buy the 16 GB version to save 400 zł.
quotes: 32 GB or it is not worth carrying.
findings: Refurb stock appears and vanishes within a day.
The shop's education price needs a document this sample does not have.

options.name: Fieldbook 16, 32 GB
options.notes: Current list price. Matte panel.

options.name: Fieldbook 16, 16 GB
options.notes: Too little memory. Listed so the gap is visible.

options.name: Fieldbook 16, 32 GB refurb
options.notes: No link. VAT status unknown until the listing says who the seller is.

nextSteps: Check the refurb listing once more next week.
Confirm the matte panel is the one in stock, not the glossy photo.

topics.title: In-desk power socket
topics.summary: A black grommet socket for the light wood desk: two mains plugs and two USB-C ports, flush when closed.
topics.decision: Leaning toward the 80 mm black grommet. Measure the existing hole before ordering the 60 mm one.
findings: The desk hole looks closer to 80 mm than 60 mm.
USB-C at 30 W is enough for a phone, not for the laptop.

options.name: Black grommet 80 mm, 2× USB-C
options.notes: Pick if the hole is 80 mm.

options.name: Black grommet 60 mm
options.notes: Only if the hole is the smaller size.

topics.title: Quiet mini PC
topics.summary: A small always-on box for builds and a browser. No decision, just a price band.
topics.decision: No pick yet. Anything under 2 500 zł with 32 GB is worth a second look. Ignore fanless cases that throttle.
quotes: Just looking. Do not add one to the basket.
findings: Fanless boxes in this size throttle after a few minutes of compile.
One listing never stated a gross price, only a net figure on a forum post.

options.name: Nook Mini 32 GB
options.notes: Has a fan. Closest to the budget.

options.name: Nook Mini barebone
options.notes: Price was never written down. Shown so an empty price does not break the table.

topics.summary: Whether the city builder is playable on the current laptop, and whether the sale price is real.
topics.decision: Just looking. Wait for a sale under 80 zł. Do not pre-order the expansion.
quotes: Only if it is under 80 zł.
findings: The laptop runs the game at low settings.
The expansion is a separate purchase and is not in the base sale.

topics.title: Bookshelf speakers
topics.summary: A small pair for the desk, powered by an existing amplifier. Passive, not a Bluetooth brick.
topics.decision: Recommended pair is the Birch Mini at 1 590 zł from Sample Audio. The imported driver is a parts option, priced in euros, and is not the pick.
quotes: Passive. I already have an amp.
findings: The Birch Mini is sold as a pair.
The euro driver is one speaker, so a pair is double the sticker.
Stands are extra and not in the speaker price.

options.name: Birch Mini (pair)
options.notes: Pick. Pair, black baffles.

options.name: Birch Mini (pair)
options.notes: Same pair, higher sticker. Kept to show two shops.

options.name: Paper cone driver, each
options.notes: Euro price, per piece. Not a finished speaker.

nextSteps: Listen to the Birch Mini in a shop if a demo pair exists.

topics.title: Office chair
topics.summary: A chair with a headrest and a 30-day return. The sample shortlist is two models from the same fictional brand.
topics.decision: Try the Sit Sample Pro first because of the headrest. The cheaper Sit Sample One is the value comparison, not the order.
quotes: Headrest, then the return window, then the price.
findings: Both chairs claim a VAT invoice and a courier return.
Crossed-out prices on the sample page are marketing, not a measured discount.
The grey Pro is a different variant and is not in this table.

options.name: Sit Sample Pro (black)
options.notes: Pick to test. Headrest height and angle, 30-day courier return.

options.name: Sit Sample One (black)
options.notes: Value comparison. No tilt tension.

nextSteps: Order the black Pro only after a yes. Use a VAT invoice.

topics.title: Espresso machine
topics.summary: A compact machine for two cups in the morning. No grinder built in; there is already a separate grinder.
topics.decision: Recommended pick is the Kettle & Steam Compact at 1 899 zł. The pod machine is cheaper and was rejected.
findings: The compact machine heats in under a minute in the sample spec sheet.
The pod machine's running cost is the pods, which this list does not try to model.

options.name: Kettle & Steam Compact
options.notes: Pick. 15 bar, no built-in grinder.

options.name: Pod Counter
options.notes: Rejected. Included so the cheaper wrong answer stays visible.

nextSteps: Confirm the drip tray fits the cupboard height.

topics.title: 32-inch desk monitor
topics.summary: One 32-inch 4K panel for the desk, with USB-C power so the laptop uses a single cable. Budget around 2 000 zł net.
topics.decision: Recommended pick is the Plainview 32 at 1 369 zł gross (1 113,01 zł net) from Sample Displays. The brighter panel is over the budget.
quotes: One cable. 4K. Under two thousand net if we can.
findings: USB-C power above 65 W covers the laptop.
The 1 369 zł price is the same at two sample shops; the table keeps both.
A third panel had a price that was never verified, so it stays unmarked as a pick.

options.name: Plainview 32 4K
options.notes: Pick. 90 W USB-C.

quotes: Rent first. Buying a garage is a different project.
findings: Month, day, and hour listings use different price periods.
Private classifieds do not get a net price.
The sale prices are round sample figures, not valuations.

topics.title: Speaker foam rings
topics.summary: Replacement foam for an old pair of speakers. A small parts order, not a new speaker.
topics.decision: Buy two foam rings from Sample Parts. The generic pack is the same part without a size printed on the listing.
quotes: Two rings. Check the diameter twice.
findings: The printed diameter is 20 cm. A 18 cm ring will not stretch.

topics.decision: Postponed. The parts list is fine; the time is not. Reopen after the monitor and chair are done.
